label: Discovery interview
description: Eliciting a complete process from a domain expert before authoring IR.
attribution: Distilled in FlowForge's own words from Lenny's Product Skills v2.0 (MIT) by Refound AI — github.com/refoundai/lenny-skills.
questions: Who touches this process, and which roles always act together?
What starts it, and what does 'done' look like?
Walk me through the last time this actually ran, step by step.
Where does it branch, and what goes wrong at each branch?
Where does work cross from one role to another — and what documents or payments move separately?
checks: Trigger and every end outcome are captured
Happy path comes from the last actual run, not the ideal
Every gateway branch has a label
No orphan branches or steps with unnamed owners
